= Tax-lien / real-estate seminar and tour research =

**Reviewed:** 2026-11-04
**Status:** no specific historical flyer or intended promoter/event has been identified. The leads below are not being presented as the user's target. The “Datto tour” is excluded as requested.

== Finding ==

Public records show several promoters using hotel stops, and a few participant reports mention hotel conference rooms or ballrooms. None of the material located so far establishes the target event by an original, dated flyer that ties together its promoter, date, hotel, and room. Search-result snippets, current route pages, attendee posts, generic seminar photos, and hotel venue descriptions are not substitutes for that flyer.

The strongest usable leads are **Tax Lien Wealth Builders / the older United Tax Liens name**, **Tax Lien Code**, and **Premier Tax Liens**. They are separate names/businesses in the material reviewed; they should not be collapsed into one tour or promoter without primary-source proof.

== Evidence labels used here ==

- **A — primary dated event record:** original organizer/venue page or contemporary flyer naming event/date/venue.
- **B — corroborated dated record:** contemporary trade press, official venue calendar, or organizer page with only some details missing.
- **C — secondary/indexed lead:** search-indexed route page, attendee account, or secondary event listing; useful for follow-up, not proof of room/flyer.
- **D — context only:** hotel or generic seminar evidence that does not identify the target event.

== Ballroom and flyer checks ==

- Targeted image searches for “Tax Lien Code,” “Premier Tax Liens,” and hotel/ballroom/flyer terms returned current seminar-room photos and generic promotional material, not a dated historical flyer identifying the target. The room images show a training setup but do not establish the hotel, city, date, or ballroom name.
- AARP's [2021 Zurixx hotel-ballroom seminar report](https://www.aarp.org/podcasts/the-perfect-scam/info-2021/get-rich-quick-seminar.html) concerns a separate real-estate seminar and is **not** tax-lien event evidence.
- The [2018 NTLA professional-conference record](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2018/02/13/1340014/0/en/NATION-S-LARGEST-TAX-LIEN-CONFERENCE-TO-BE-HELD-IN-FORT-LAUDERDALE-FLORIDA-February-28-MARCH-2-2018.html) and its hotel context concern an industry association conference, not a consumer seminar roadshow.
- Older Tax Lien Code Dallas/Charleston event URLs were unavailable; surviving snippets and route pages are leads, not original flyers.
- “Datto tour” results were unrelated IT events. They are excluded from the candidate list.

== What would identify the intended event ==

The most useful next clue is any one of: approximate year; city or hotel name; flyer photo/PDF; distinctive headline or tagline; promoter/person's name; or an attendee invitation/confirmation with personal details redacted. With one of those, the search can be narrowed to archived organizer pages, venue calendars, newspaper advertisements, and contemporary local reporting. Without a seed, assigning the event to TLWB, Tax Lien Code, or Premier Tax Liens would be speculation.
